purpose: Design for extracting formal references, verifying link targets by directory scan, detecting content-hash mismatches, and notifying change-impact candidates and inconsistency checks.
summary: Formal references are extracted from reference-link definitions whose title ends with a DLID
Directory scan classifies targets as match, path mismatch, or absent, with fragment checks
Path-fix guidance is given only when a unique entity is confirmed by the scan
Links without a DLID get a suggested title value computed from the current target
Reverse references are built from scanned sources and the confirmed ToC
Recorded content hashes are compared with current hashes to list impact candidates
Notifications persist until the project management AI rewrites the recorded hash
doc-link never edits documents or judges whether a source needs fixing
Inconsistency checks are split into check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact
tasks: Designing reference extraction and title parsing
Writing tests for reference and impact detection
Fixing broken or mismatched document links
title: DES-007 参照検査と[変更影響候補の通知]
